out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label. Observed no dates written on the oyster shellstock tags.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO WRITE THE DATE ON THE TAG WHEN THE LAST PIECE FROM THE BATCH WAS SOLD/SERVED. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH SHELLSTOCK GUIDANCE.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The two ice machines at the bar were observed with black and blue discoloration on the interior.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PIC TURNED OFF OF THE ICE MACHINES. MAINTENANCE WILL CLEAN ICE MACHINES LATER IN THE DAY.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the walk-in cooler in the kitchen: chickpea stew was observed at 50f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE STEW.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) heated heavy cream 2) sour cream 3) house blue cheese dressing
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) high temperature dish machine at bar, right side. Observed at 157f.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. DISCONTINUE USE OF THIS DISH MACHINE UNTIL IT CAN PROPERLY HEAT SANITIZE AT 160f.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed a staff member rinse beverage glasses in the handsink by the espresso machine.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMBER TO RINSE BEVERAGE GLASSES AT THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. STAFF MEMBER MOVED THE GLASSES TO THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Observed a shallow pan of mussels with no shellstock tag in the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. CHEF COULD NOT PRODUCE THE SHELLSTOCK TAG FOR MUSSELS. CHEF DISCARDED THE MUSSELS. ALL SHELLSTOCK TAGS MUST BE RETAINED FOR 90 DAYS. ALL TAGS MUST HAVE THE DATE WHEN THE LAST PIECE OF THAT BATCH WAS SOLD.

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: Observed a parasite destruction letter that only stated the salmon is pellet fed. The letter did not indicate whether the salmon were raised in net pens in open waters or some sort of land-based operation.
violations.corrective_action: Contact your fish supplier and ask for a written statement stating that the fish were raised in net pens if in open water OR land-based operations AND fed formulated feed that contains no live parasites. FAX a copy of this letter to your inspector and keep this statement on site at the food establishment for 90 days beyond the time of service of the fish. CONTACT THE SALMON SUPPLIER TO PROVIDE A PARASITE DESTRUCTION THAT INCLUDES A FARM-RAISED OPERATION AND PELLET-FED. EMAIL EHS WITH AN UPDATED LETTER BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: Observed several unlabeled squeeze bottles of oils and glazes at the pantry station.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CHEF INSTRUCTED STAFF TO LABEL THE SQUEEZE BOTTLES.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed staff member use a drinking cup to scoop ice from the ice bin. Observed a small deli container being stored in the bulk rice bin. Observed the handle of the scoop lying in the sugar of the bulk sugar bin.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMBER TO USE THE SCOOP WITH THE HANDLE TO SCOOP ICE. CHEF REMOVED THE DELI CONTAINER AND STUCK THE SCOOP INTO THE SUGAR WITH THE HANDLE STICKING UPWARDS.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 165F
violations.observation: The hot water in the high temperature dishwashing machine was observed at 158f using EHS’s high temperature dish plate.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THE HIGH TEMPERATURE FOR SANITIZATION. DISH MACHINE CAN BE USE TO WASH AND RINSE. SANITIZING SHALL BE DONE AT THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. SOAK DISHES FOR 30 -60 SECONDS AND ALLOW TO AIR DRY. PIC WILL CALL A SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR THE MACHINE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: In the 3DR prep top cooler (for Hot Apps), the following food was observed out of temperature: arugula (63f), blue cheese crumbles (64f), pulled pork (53f), sliced deli ham (48f). Upon discussion with PIC, food was put on the in this prep top cooler within 2 hours. In the 1DR prep top cooler (for dressing), the following food was observed out of temperature: sour cream (45f), whipped cream (45f). Upon discussion with PIC, these food in this cooler was kept overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED ALL THE FOOD OUT OF THE 3DR PREP TOP COOLER TO THE WALK-IN COOLER TO COOL TO 41f. PIC DISCARDED THE SOUR CREAM AND WHIPPED CREAM.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: Observed black discoloration in the ice machine in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. THOROUGHLY CLEAN ICE MACHINE.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed knives being stored in a small gap of a prep top cooler. Observed an ice scoop being improperly stored inside the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC MOVED THE UTENSILS TO THE DISH AREA TO BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 3DR prep top cooler (Hot Apps) was observed at 48f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE HAVE A SERVICE TECHNICIAN REPAIR COOLER. COOLERS WORK BEST WHEN SET TO 32f-38f.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: A high temperature dish plate or heat sensitive test strips to verify heat sanitization were not found on site.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PIC ORDERED A HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH PLATE DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: An approved backflow prevention device was not observed on the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PURCHASE AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE FOR THE MOP SINK. PIC TOOK A PICTURE OF THE APPROVED DEVICE AND WILL ORDER IT.
